works.title: Effigy in Red
works.description: A vertical totem rises against a flat vermilion ground, crowned by a photographic face fragment over a Giacometti-thin line figure. Gold compact discs anchor the upper corners; numbered fabric letters punctuate the margins.
works.composition: axial vertical totem on flat ground

works.title: Reliquary
works.description: A lace doily frames a yellow Latin cross flanked by black vertical bars, set on a dark ground beneath a violet wash. Silver compact discs are pinned at the cardinal points and along the lower edge like nail-heads.
works.composition: centered shrine on dark ground

works.title: Sortie
works.description: Two oversized gold compact discs sit in concentric black-and-white halos in the upper register; below, a top-down line drawing of a single-engine warplane is centered on a blue bullseye. A frieze of small scoring targets runs along the base, with vertical orange and black bands dividing the field.
works.composition: two-register: paired discs above, plane-on-target below

works.title: Alley, Magenta Figure
works.description: A narrow alley wall is dense with overlapping graffiti and tags in saturated red, turquoise, yellow and lime. A magenta-skinned figure in yellow sunglasses, painted in a Basquiat-meets-comic register, occupies the central wall above a parked motorbike.

works.title: Endgame
works.description: Two top-down warplane line drawings drift across a silver foil ground, partially overlapping. A wooden chess king stands as a counterweight at lower left; silver compact discs anchor the upper corners and beaded fringes hang at the base.
works.composition: diagonal pair on metallic ground

works.title: Squadron with Pink Vinyl
works.description: A pink vinyl record and a gold compact disc anchor a metallic field crossed by two top-down line-drawn warplanes set at angles. A wooden chess king stands at right; small target stickers, beaded threads and gold-foil scraps drift across the surface.
works.composition: diagonal plane axis with chess weight right

works.title: Procession
works.description: A strict vertical totem on a light ground: a small top-down warplane at the apex, then a row of seven gold and silver discs strung like a necklace, then a haloed gold disc at center, with a black-and-white photographic strip and a final disc at the base. Yellow vertical bands frame the procession.
works.composition: axial vertical totem on light ground

works.title: Drafting Table
works.description: A large top-down warplane line drawing fills the upper field on open white paper, flanked by yellow vertical bands. Below, a tight frieze of small objects — perforated dot rows, a gold honeycomb panel with a turquoise star, a football, two silver discs and a target.
works.composition: open upper field, dense lower frieze

works.title: Treasury
works.description: Two top-down warplanes overlap diagonally on a textured gold-leaf and silver-foil ground, one ghosted with bullseye eyes. A wooden chess king holds the lower-left corner; gold and iridescent discs cluster in the corners over a faint scoring sheet.
works.composition: diagonal plane crossover on metallic ground

works.title: Float
works.description: A central top-down warplane carries iridescent discs as wheels and propellers on a perforated pegboard ground. A dense pile of additional discs, target rings, ink splashes and torn map fragments crowds the base, framed above by yellow vertical ribbons.
works.composition: axial totem on dotted ground, dense base pile

works.title: Untitled (Three Discs Descending)
works.description: Three silver compact discs cascade down a gold-foil ground over a top-down line drawing of a single-engine warplane. Strips of red lettering and small game-target stickers line the upper edge; the surface is densely worked, with overlapping foils and crease marks.
works.composition: diagonal cascade of discs over central plane

works.title: Untitled (Iridescent Squadron)
works.description: A top-down warplane drawing presides over a dense field crossed by three iridescent compact discs and orange vertical bands. A frieze of numbered targets and small painted icons lines the lower register; red and black accents punctuate throughout.
works.composition: central plane with disc constellation, target frieze base

works.title: Hieroglyph
works.description: An Egyptian wall-painting fragment of a seated deity is centered on a light ground, framed by yellow vertical bands and partially eclipsed by a top-down warplane drawing rising from below. Gold compact discs anchor the upper corners; sequins and target stickers cluster at the base.
works.composition: centered iconographic panel with framing bands

works.title: Disc Crucifix
works.description: A sculptural cross of iridescent compact discs is mounted at the upper left of a tall white-and-black backing panel. Tangled strings drip from the discs across the lower black field; the whole reads as a relic suspended on a wall.
works.composition: asymmetric cross at upper left, dripping strings below

works.title: Gold Cross
works.description: A vertical cross of patterned gold panels is studded with four gold compact discs, set against a red square on a black ground. The construction is glossed with reflective tape and reads as a small reliquary or icon.
works.composition: centered cross on red square, black ground

works.title: Fuselage and Helmet
works.description: A top-down warplane line drawing dominates the upper field, with three silver compact discs anchoring the corners and lower edge. A central engine-or-target form glows with yellow rays; an American football and a football helmet sit in the lower base alongside a clipped color frieze.
works.composition: central plane on light field, dense base frieze

works.title: Untitled (Football and Vinyl)
works.description: A blue vinyl record sits at top alongside a silver compact disc and a large gold disc at center. The lower field is a dense pop strip of football trading cards, helmets, footballs and color blocks; pixelated patterns and grids fill the gaps.
works.composition: discs upper, sport-card frieze lower

works.title: Formation
works.description: Multiple top-down warplane line drawings stack in a vertical formation against a field crowded with gold compact discs, red rocket-fin shapes and concentric target rings. Vertical orange and black bands divide the composition; printed numerals and tags pile at the base.
works.composition: vertical squadron with disc and target field

works.title: Untitled (Polaroid Drift)
works.description: A top-down warplane drifts down the left edge while three gold compact discs float across the field. A small grid of polaroid-style portraits and printed snapshots threads through the center, with target rings and red and yellow ribbons accenting the surface.
works.composition: left-aligned plane with disc and snapshot drift

works.title: Untitled (Plane and Disc, Wide)
works.description: A horizontal panorama: a top-down warplane glides left of center over vertical color bands, while a single oversized gold compact disc anchors the far right. Polaroid snapshots, target rings and ladder forms cluster in the middle band.
works.composition: wide horizontal panorama, asymmetric weighting right

works.title: Wide Score
works.description: A horizontal panorama: an iridescent compact disc inside a red bullseye anchors the left, an iridescent disc with a black-and-white photographic head anchors the right. Between them, a graffitied middle ground with planes, a soccer ball and clipped color blocks.
works.composition: horizontal panorama with twin disc anchors

works.title: Crowned Plane
works.description: A stylized green crown caps the upper edge above a top-down warplane line drawing rising from a large concentric target at the base. Vertical orange bands cross the field; silver and gold compact discs anchor corners and an American football peeks from the lower frieze.
works.composition: axial vertical with crown apex and target base

works.title: Bombsight
works.description: A large top-down warplane sits centered on stacked concentric target rings, framed above by a row of bullseye-circle eyes and patterned panels. Three gold discs anchor the corners; vertical red and orange bands frame the field, with snapshots and stickers in the lower margin.
works.composition: central plane on stacked targets, axial symmetry

works.title: Tongue and Plane
works.description: A horizontal panorama: a top-down warplane drifts across a yellow-and-red striped field flanked by silver compact discs. Two Rolling Stones tongue logos appear at right above a small football; a concentric red bullseye sits at center.
works.composition: horizontal panorama, twin disc anchors with central target

works.title: Cloud Garden
works.description: A pale blue and white field is loosely painted with a soft cloud or flower silhouette; four gold compact discs cluster at center as fruits or seeds. A small line-drawn warplane appears at the lower edge above hand-drawn grass strokes.
works.composition: soft painted ground with central disc cluster

works.title: Yellow Figure on Black Wall
works.description: A spray-painted yellow figure on a swirling magenta-and-orange spray cloud occupies a black graffitied wall. Turquoise tag lettering crosses the lower half; small white tags and dripping signatures fill the surrounding surface.

works.title: Untitled (Twin Planes)
works.description: Two top-down warplane drawings stack vertically on a gold-foil ground. Three gold compact discs anchor the upper field; a small linear bird and a band of sequined dots sit below the lower plane.
works.composition: vertical stack of plane pair on metallic ground

works.title: Installation View, Wall of Works
works.description: An installation photograph: a yellow gallery wall hung salon-style with a dense grid of small mixed-media works in the artist's signature vocabulary of footballs, targets, and concentric circles. Saturated reds, blacks and yellows dominate.

works.title: Installation View, Crowd
works.description: Wide installation photograph of a large white-ground mural densely covered in concentric circles, planes, footballs and target patterns. Three viewers stand in silhouette in the foreground, giving scale.

works.title: Untitled (Diving Plane)
works.description: A blue-tinted top-down warplane drawing dives across the upper field, fragmenting as it descends. Three gold compact discs sit in a horizontal row across a pale grid below; small numbered icons and a fourth disc cluster at the lower edge.
works.composition: diving plane upper, horizontal disc row lower

works.title: Stuka, Watch Out
works.description: A side-view Stuka dive-bomber plunges from the upper edge over the partial blue text 'WATCH OUT.' Below, a cubist line-drawn weeping figure emerges from a target field, anchored by a silver compact disc at the lower left.
works.composition: diving plane upper, weeping figure lower

works.title: Long Frieze
works.description: A wide horizontal frieze packed with the artist's recurring vocabulary: yellow vertical bands, repeating bullseye targets, footballs, fragments of warplanes and dripping black ink. Reads as a stretched-out manifesto strip across the white ground.
works.composition: wide horizontal frieze, dense uniform pattern

works.title: Untitled (Twin Discs in Targets)
works.description: A wide horizontal composition with two large iridescent compact discs in concentric black-and-white target rings flanking a central plane fragment and football. Vertical yellow and red bands punctuate the field; small chess and figure cutouts populate the lower edge.
works.composition: horizontal panorama, twin disc targets framing center

works.title: Hangar
works.description: A horizontal triptych of densely packed aviation collage: planes, targets, fragmented blueprints and color blocks. A central yellow panel frames a stenciled figure between two dense outer panels of warplanes and ink splashes.
works.composition: horizontal triptych, framed central panel

works.title: Untitled (Plane Diptych)
works.description: A horizontal diptych: each panel centered on a top-down warplane drawing surrounded by gold compact discs and concentric target rings. Vertical color bands and small figural cutouts thread between the planes; black-and-white photo strips line the upper margins.
works.composition: horizontal diptych, twin plane-and-disc panels

works.title: Roundel Field
works.description: A horizontal panorama: dense rows of red-white-and-blue concentric roundels carpet the field, with two top-down warplane drawings emerging at center and right. Silver compact discs and small clipped fragments scatter throughout.
works.composition: horizontal panorama, all-over roundel field

works.title: Snake on a Stairwell
works.description: A black exterior fire-escape stairwell hosts a large white-line snake mural with bared fangs sweeping diagonally across the wall. Air-conditioning units cluster at top; a small toast-character paste-up sits at the base beside a red trash bin.

works.title: Untitled (Football Frieze)
works.description: Wide horizontal collage: a row of bullseye targets and footballs runs across the lower margin while two top-down warplane drawings cross the upper field. Red, yellow and black accents punctuate the white ground.
works.composition: horizontal panorama, target-and-football base frieze

works.title: Resin and Rust
works.description: An asymmetric grid of four panels: two warm rust-brown resin squares on the left, a pale yellow square at lower right, and a cream square at upper right. Three gold compact discs are mounted as fasteners across the right panels.
works.composition: four-panel asymmetric grid

works.title: Roundel Procession
works.description: A vertical totem composition: a top-down warplane descends through a field saturated with red-blue-yellow concentric roundels. Yellow vertical bands frame the procession; a small framed snapshot and a football break the rhythm in the center.
works.composition: vertical procession on all-over roundel ground

works.title: Untitled (Sketch, Pink Ball)
works.description: A loosely composed horizontal field with a framed inset at left containing a top-down warplane and a pink football. Concentric roundels and small CDs scatter across the upper edge; a vertical right-side strip of stacked discs and stripes acts as a counterweight.
works.composition: asymmetric horizontal with framed inset left

works.title: Inventory 10054
works.description: A central black panel holds stacked target rings, a scribbled pulley diagram and the inventory number '10054'. Footballs anchor the lower corners; small clipped photographs and figural cutouts cluster at the edges, with a yellow rays-and-sun motif at base center.
works.composition: central black panel with corner-football anchors

works.title: Untitled (Helicopter on Targets)
works.description: A central helicopter line drawing crosses a field thick with concentric red-and-black target rings and yellow vertical bands. A wooden chess king stands at upper right; small color cutouts and pink ribbon accents dot the lower margin.
works.composition: central helicopter on dense target field

works.title: Cardboard Field
works.description: Quiet brown corrugated-cardboard field interrupted by a vivid orange rectangle at upper center and a turquoise football icon below. Small printed snapshots and two CDs anchor the lower edge; restrained palette unusual for the artist.
works.composition: muted cardboard field with orange focal block

works.title: Untitled (Target Field, Wide)
works.description: A horizontal field densely sown with concentric target rings of varying scale, sweeping spiral curves and red linear strokes. A blue-and-white striped fan radiates from the lower left; small clipped icons and CDs punctuate the surface.
works.composition: wide horizontal panorama, all-over target field

works.title: Untitled (Plane Totem with Text)
works.description: A vertical totem composition: a small football-and-helmet panel above a top-down warplane drawing, framed by red-and-black target rings and the painted word 'WHAT'. A chess piece anchors the lower left; vertical color bands and a target frieze close the bottom.
works.composition: axial vertical totem with text band

works.title: Crown of Polaroids
works.description: A red Basquiat-style three-point crown caps a horizontal band of small color polaroids. Below, a large gold compact disc on a wagon-wheel halo and a smaller silver disc, with an American football and a small line-drawn warplane upper right.
works.composition: crown above polaroid band, disc and football below

works.title: Rhode, White Figure
works.description: A black exterior wall hosts a tall white painted nude figure pasted up beneath yellow spray-painted text reading 'RHODE'. A cartoon Mr. Snowmann tag sits at left; a wide-eyed character and small running figure are tagged at lower left.
works.composition: central pasted figure on dark wall

works.title: Untitled (Dense Field)
works.description: A wide horizontal field densely packed with footballs, target rings and red-and-black vertical bands. Multiple bullseye eyes and small icons swarm across the surface; the rhythm is restless and saturated.
works.composition: wide horizontal panorama, all-over dense field

works.title: Dad, Two Footballs
works.description: A central framed inset shows a top-down warplane against a black ground with a red football. Around it, target rings, two more footballs and the hand-painted word 'DAD' at lower right; a yellow rectangle and small figural cutouts complete the surface.
works.composition: framed inset center, target satellites

works.title: Foil Cross
works.description: A horizontal mirror-foil panel hosts a vertical cross studded with gold compact discs, with discs scattered across the lower half. Red ribbon strips drip down the foil; small printed labels flank the left edge.
works.composition: central cross on horizontal foil ground

works.title: Guernica
works.description: Densely packed square composition: top-down warplane drawings rise from a base inscribed 'GUERNICA', surrounded by footballs, target rings and silver compact discs. The signature war narrative compacted into a single saturated panel.
works.composition: square dense field with text base

works.title: Untitled (Framed Plane on Targets)
works.description: A framed central work: two gold compact discs at the upper edge sit above a top-down warplane drawing centered on stacked target rings. A frieze of small bullseye targets runs along the lower margin; orange and black accents punctuate the white field.
works.composition: framed central plane on stacked targets

works.title: Untitled (Two Boards)
works.description: Two stacked rectangular panels: the upper has a black chess king and music note, the lower a red-and-black 'PINTE' panel with chess pieces. Silver compact discs ring the outer edge; small icons and text scribbles fill the margins.
works.composition: two stacked panels on disc-edged ground

works.title: Untitled (Skateboards on Target Field)
works.description: A wide horizontal field saturated with concentric target rings of varying scale. Two black skateboards anchor the lower edge; a red-bordered grid of game-board lines and small color icons crosses the upper field.
works.composition: wide horizontal panorama, all-over target field

works.title: XXIII Bus
works.description: A wide horizontal collage with two large silver compact discs at center anchoring a yellow base panel inscribed 'XXIIIBUS'. Concentric target rings, scribbled diagrams and red and green vertical bands surround the central pair.
works.composition: wide horizontal panorama, twin disc center

works.title: Untitled (Three Planes, Yellow)
works.description: A muted yellow ground hosts three top-down warplane drawings arranged across the horizontal field. Concentric target rings ring the outer edges; small black-and-white photo strips and pale color washes thread between the planes.
works.composition: horizontal trio of planes on muted ground

works.title: Untitled (Plane Grid, OTHER)
works.description: A grid of stacked panels, each carrying a top-down warplane drawing or target rings. The painted word 'OTHER' appears repeatedly across the columns; footballs and concentric circles fill the gaps between panels.
works.composition: grid of panels with repeated text

works.title: Occupy Democracy
works.description: A black wall beside a white Georgian door (no. 178A) hosts a tall yellow paste-up of a crowned figure with 'occupydemocracy' tags repeated alongside. Two small Mr. Snowmann tags and a stencil signature mark the door frame; a black-line owl mural sweeps across the lower right.
works.composition: central paste-up beside Georgian doorway

works.title: Guernica, Tall
works.description: A vertical totem composition titled 'GUERNICA' across the top: warplanes scatter from the upper edge over a central panel of fragmented faces and ruins, descending to a base of four black-and-white photographic strips and silver compact discs. Red ink dominates the upper register.
works.composition: axial vertical totem with text crown

works.title: Falling City
works.description: A vertical narrative on a white field: a turquoise warplane plunges from the upper edge over twin photographic faces, descending through a red flag panel to a base of black-and-white aerial-bombardment photographs of a ruined city.
works.composition: axial vertical totem, narrative descent

works.title: Guernica, Bomber Above
works.description: A two-color flag composition: a top-down four-engine bomber drawing crowns the cyan upper field above the painted word 'GUERNICA'; a red square below holds a black-and-white photograph of the bombed town under the green base inscribed with the same.
works.composition: two-register flag, bomber over destruction photograph

works.title: Foil Cross with Wires
works.description: A sculptural cross of crumpled silver foil studded with mismatched compact discs is mounted on a reflective foil ground. White wires drip down from the discs across the lower half; a small purple wing fragment hangs at center.
works.composition: central cross on foil ground with dripping wires

works.title: Untitled (Page on Bands)
works.description: A central white blank page, splattered with paint drips, is suspended on yellow vertical bands over a saturated field of red, blue and white concentric roundels. Two gold compact discs anchor the lower edge as wheels.
works.composition: central blank panel on roundel field, disc base

works.title: Cassette
works.description: A cassette-tape composition: yellow vertical bands occupy the upper rectangle, framed by black sides studded with cassette-spool icons; below, two large gold compact discs sit as cassette reels, with smaller discs spilling onto the lower edge.
works.composition: cassette-shaped panel with disc reels

works.title: Untitled (Page on Targets)
works.description: A central pinned page with two silver compact discs and a hovering UFO-like form is framed by an outer field of red-and-black concentric target rings. A black chess king stands at lower left; smaller discs scatter at the base.
works.composition: central pinned page on target field

works.title: Untitled (Three Discs, Wide)
works.description: A wide horizontal field with three silver compact discs floating across the upper register and a row of bullseye targets along the base. Red and blue vertical bands at the right edge; small football and chess king cutouts punctuate the lower margin.
works.composition: wide horizontal panorama with disc trio

works.title: Untitled (Three Discs, Quiet)
works.description: A spare composition: three silver compact discs descend diagonally across a near-empty white field, with a tiny top-down warplane drawing at the base. Pinprick perforations line the left and right edges; a single red strip closes the bottom.
works.composition: diagonal disc descent on near-empty field

works.title: Untitled (Twin Planes with Discs)
works.description: Two horizontal warplane line drawings stack in the central register, surrounded by gold and silver compact discs and concentric rings. Pink, magenta and yellow ribbon stripes punctuate the field; a chess king stands at lower left and a bullseye anchors the base.
works.composition: central twin planes with disc and ribbon field

works.title: Stencil Girl, Brick Wall
works.description: A black-and-white stencil of a young girl holding a doily-patterned object is sprayed on a weathered yellow brick wall. Two small Mr. Snowmann tags and a spray-can stencil mark the upper edge of the wall.
works.composition: central stencil on brick wall

works.title: Untitled (White Frame, Crowded Margins)
works.description: Crowded margins frame a near-empty central white panel: silver and gold compact discs, footballs, target rings, chess pieces and a soccer ball cluster densely along the four edges. The empty center reads as a pause within a busy field.
works.composition: empty centre with crowded perimeter

works.title: London, Liverpool
works.description: Three gold compact discs anchor an inset white square at center, tagged with the painted words 'london' below and 'LIVERPOOL' on a yellow tab. A small line-drawn warplane, target rings and a black-and-white photographic strip frame the inset.
works.composition: central inset with text tabs

works.title: Untitled (Three Discs Above OTHER)
works.description: Three silver compact discs cluster in the central register over a base inscribed 'OTHER'. A small top-down warplane rises at the upper edge; a row of red-and-black bullseye targets and a magenta football line the lower frieze.
works.composition: central disc cluster with text base

works.title: Surprise
works.description: Two top-down warplane drawings drift across the upper white field, one trailing a small cloud and red flag boxes; the painted word 'SURPRISE' marks the right edge. A horizontal row of gold compact discs and twin red bullseyes runs along the base. A wooden chess king stands at upper left.
works.composition: open upper field, disc-and-target frieze base

works.title: Cassette Altar
works.description: A vertical wall assemblage on a black ground: a row of empty cassette-tape cases at the top studded with iridescent compact discs, blue ribbon strips drip down to a central altar of crumpled silver foil and clustered discs. A computer keyboard fragment closes the base.
works.composition: vertical altar with cascading ribbons

works.title: Bomber, Black Ground
works.description: On a black ground a single white-line top-down bomber drawing hovers central, with two silver compact discs flanking targets at the lower edge. A small white chess king floats at upper left; teal accent strips punctuate the right side.
works.composition: central bomber on black ground, target base

works.title: Untitled (Plane on Empty Page)
works.description: A central blank white panel hosts a single top-down warplane drawing, framed in orange and ringed by the artist's vocabulary: target rings, additional planes, two gold compact discs at the lower edge, and pale yellow vertical drips down the surrounding margin.
works.composition: central blank panel within bordered frame

works.title: XXIII Discs
works.description: A red-bordered frame holds a flock of top-down warplane drawings; three silver compact discs scale across the field. Vertical orange stripes drip down the white ground; a green X on a purple square anchors the centre, with target rings and a magenta football along the base. Inscribed 'XXIII DBS' lower right.
works.composition: framed plane swarm with disc descent

works.title: Negative Squadron
works.description: Negative-image variant: a black-ground panel hosts white-line top-down warplanes stacked vertically, framed by perforated borders and a base frieze of black-and-white concentric targets. Two silver compact discs sit in the lower margin.
works.composition: axial squadron on black ground, target base

works.title: XXIII Discs, Blue
works.description: Companion to the red-bordered XXIII piece, recast in cobalt blue: vertical blue stripes carry a flock of warplanes; iridescent and silver compact discs scatter across the upper field. Black-and-white target rings cluster at the base; inscribed 'XXIII DBS' lower right.
works.composition: axial squadron on blue striped ground

works.title: Star of David, Snowman
works.description: A street wall painted purple and red carries a Star of David containing a small white snowman on a red triangle, and a stylized rifle filling the upper triangle. Painted text fragments and ink drips frame the panel; an unmistakable Mr. Snowmann composition.
works.composition: central Star of David with figure

works.title: Football Drift
works.description: A near-empty white field hosts a top-down warplane drawing at the upper centre and a large pasted American football mid-field. Concentric target rings cluster at the corners over black-and-white photographic strips and small icons.
works.composition: central football on near-empty field

works.title: Merry Christmas 2013
works.description: A spare drawing-as-greeting on white paper: a small fighter plane at upper centre approaches a large four-engine bomber at the base, with a circular trace and a target between them. Inscribed 'Merry Christmas 2013' along the lower margin.
works.composition: spare narrative drawing with text base

works.title: Football, Black Ground
works.description: On a near-black ground a single American football looms at centre, surrounded by small bullseye eyes, scattered photographic snapshots and a wide horizontal red line. Hot-pink accents flicker at the upper edge; a small line-drawn warplane at the right.
works.composition: central football on dark ground

works.title: Merry Christmas 2013, Black
works.description: Companion to the white-ground Christmas piece, recast on a black ground: a small green-and-white fighter at the upper centre approaches a four-engine bomber at the base. Two gold compact discs hang in the upper field; a circular ghost trace centres the composition.
works.composition: spare narrative drawing on black ground

works.title: Yellow Frame, Blank Page
works.description: A yellow vertical frame holds a near-empty central white panel, ringed by columns of bullseye targets and gold compact discs. A line-drawn warplane crowns the upper edge; a wooden chess king at lower left, with a black-and-white photograph and small text strip at the base.
works.composition: yellow frame around blank centre, target columns

works.title: Tower Altar
works.description: A vertical wall altar on a black ground: an upper canopy of speakers and brown corrugated panels, a central crumpled silver-foil totem with red ribbon descents, and a base of stacked white-and-blue printed strips fringed with hanging cables.
works.composition: vertical altar with canopy, foil torso, base frieze

works.title: Yellow Frame with Two Kings
works.description: Variant of the yellow-frame composition with twin chess kings — one black at lower left, one white at lower right — flanking a central blank panel. Silver and red bullseye target rings line the columns; a top-down warplane drawing crowns the top edge.
works.composition: yellow frame with twin chess anchors

works.title: Night Mission
works.description: A dark-ground composition: a fighter at the upper centre and a four-engine bomber at the base flank a black inset of a ruined city skyline. Iridescent and pink target rings descend in vertical columns; a chess king at lower left.
works.composition: axial vertical with target columns flanking ruin inset

works.title: Red Stage, Two Planes
works.description: A central red stage panel hosts a black-and-white photograph of an animal carcass and a small face below; two top-down warplane drawings hover above on purple drip columns. Black-and-white concentric targets cluster in the corners and along the lower edge.
works.composition: central red stage with twin planes above

works.title: Football, Three Discs, Green Stripe
works.description: Three silver compact discs cluster across the lower half of a near-empty white field, with a fourth disc upper right. A single green vertical band drops from a maroon football panel at top; small target rings and CD fragments line the lower edge. A scribbled bicycle silhouette runs through the centre.
works.composition: spare central field with disc cluster and green band

works.title: Sticker Wall, CAID
works.description: A close-up street photograph of a stickered wall packed with paste-ups: 'CAID', 'STAR CHARACTER', 'TOIZ', 'MORE STREET FOR ART', and a central white skull-faced Mr. Snowmann tag at the centre. Saturated reds, blues and yellows compete across the surface.
works.composition: all-over sticker collage on wall

works.title: Cyan Bombsight
works.description: A cyan-and-grey ground hosts a top-down warplane drawing centered above a grid of black-and-white photographic fragments and a small bottle illustration. Concentric target rings cluster at the corners; vertical pink and yellow drips column down the middle.
works.composition: central plane on cyan ground, axial drip columns

works.title: Black Box, Iridescent Discs
works.description: A central black panel hosts a maroon football and a chess king sketch, framed by iridescent compact discs in the corners. Pink and lavender drip columns fall through the centre; a base frieze of small CDs and printed perforation marks closes the bottom.
works.composition: central black panel with disc-corner anchors

works.title: Squadron Above Targets
works.description: A wide horizontal squadron of top-down warplanes crosses the upper field on yellow vertical drips. Below, a saturated frieze of red-and-black bullseye targets and concentric circles runs along the base; a lower bomber drawing punctuates the lower right.
works.composition: wide horizontal squadron above target frieze

works.title: Yellow Inset, How to Create
works.description: A central inset frames a top-down warplane drawing on a yellow ground, with photographic snapshots and red panels around the edges. Three gold compact discs anchor the upper field; below the inset, two iridescent discs and a chess piece sit on the white margin. Inscribed 'how to create' along the right edge.
works.composition: framed yellow inset on light field with disc anchors

works.title: Stereo Squadron
works.description: On a black ground a row of stereo speakers and components stretches across the upper register; below, three top-down warplane line drawings advance with concentric target rings flanking. A small ladder element climbs the left side; saturated cobalt and turquoise accents punctuate the dark field.
works.composition: speaker frieze above plane row, dark ground

works.title: Bomber, Disc Frame
works.description: Black borders studded with mounted compact discs run down both sides; the central white panel hosts a four-engine bomber line drawing with rivet-perforations descending below it. A maroon football and orange ribbon strip flank the lower edge; two gold discs sit at the base.
works.composition: central plane on white panel, disc-studded borders

works.title: Disc Bouquet
works.description: A vertical wall assemblage on plastic-wrapped backing: a bouquet of iridescent compact discs at the upper centre over red and blue ribbon stripes, a central horizontal pair of gold discs framing a small floral motif, and a base frieze of red ribbons studded with circular tabs. A single suspended disc hangs at the bottom.
works.composition: vertical bouquet altar, ribbon base

works.title: XXIII Discs, Yellow
works.description: Variant of the XXIII series in yellow: four gold compact discs arrange diamond-formation across the centre over a layered field of warplane drawings, equipment fragments and red blocks. Black-and-white perforated borders frame the top and bottom; a pink scribbled column drops at lower left, with a target medallion at right.
works.composition: diamond disc cluster on layered yellow ground

works.title: XXIII Discs, Magenta
works.description: Companion to the XXIII series in magenta and black: a vertical pair of top-down warplane drawings hovers central, framed by black-and-white perforated borders and dripping pink columns. A small line-drawn elephant clings to the upper left; concentric target rings flank.
works.composition: axial vertical pair on dark ground with perforated borders

works.title: Squadron and Cassettes
works.description: Five top-down warplane silhouettes stack in receding scale on a white field, the upper plane in solid colour, the lower in line drawing. Below, three blue cassette tapes carry compact discs as reels along the base.
works.composition: receding squadron above cassette base

works.title: You Call It God
works.description: A street paste-up of a black-stenciled creature holding a large white sign reading 'YOU CALL IT GOD WE CALL IT A PRANK' in red block letters. A small Mr. Snowmann tag with snowman icon sits at lower left; tag 'MEME' at right edge.
works.composition: central paste-up with text sign on cream wall

works.title: Tree of Discs
works.description: Three line-drawn warplanes descend from the upper black panel toward a black-and-white photograph of a leafy tree at centre, its trunk cradling six gold compact discs. Yellow vertical bands frame the entire composition.
works.composition: central tree photograph framed by yellow bands, planes above

works.title: Plane in the Branches
works.description: A close-up black-and-white photograph of tree branches against a sky, with a single top-down warplane line drawing perched among the leaves. A red wash bleeds through the lower trunk; the photograph reads as both leaf canopy and bombsight.
works.composition: single plane on tree-branch photograph

works.title: Guernica, Two-Engine Plan
works.description: A two-register composition on a white field: a black-and-white photograph of a top-down two-engine bomber occupies the upper third, while a three-engine plan-view drawing of the same plane fills the lower half. The base is inscribed 'GUERNICA' in heavy lettering.
works.composition: two-register: photograph above, blueprint below

works.title: Bomber Over Reclining Figure
works.description: Loose horizontal collage on cyan and white grounds: a top-down bomber drawing crosses the centre on a turquoise wash, with a black-and-white reclining nude figure at the lower right. Pink and red gestures and a torn yellow strip flank the lower margin.
works.composition: horizontal panorama, plane above, figure right

works.title: Targets and Tape
works.description: A horizontal field of taped-down patterned papers, two silver compact discs at the lower edge over fragments of music sheet and labels. Small target rings and grid patterns in graphite cross the surface; a torn red strip bleeds along the upper edge.
works.composition: horizontal taped collage with disc base

works.title: Squadron and Disc Crown
works.description: A maximalist field crammed with overlapping warplane drawings and gold compact discs. Five gold discs cluster across the upper half as a crown; below, smaller iridescent discs ring concentric targets and a base frieze of red, black and yellow blocks.
works.composition: dense field with disc crown above, target frieze below

works.title: Mirror Frame, Saturated Centre
works.description: Twin mirror-image side panels of warplane line drawings flank a saturated central panel of pop colour, scribbled targets, and clustered small icons. Silver compact discs sit at the outer corners of the panels.
works.composition: horizontal triptych with mirror flanks

works.title: Twin Tongues, Twin Targets
works.description: A wide horizontal collage on black ground: a row of warplane line drawings runs across the centre on red and yellow vertical bands. Two Rolling Stones tongue logos flank the field at left and right; gold compact discs and twin red targets cluster at centre, with a maroon football at lower right.
works.composition: wide horizontal panorama with twin tongue anchors

works.title: Reaper, Snowman
works.description: A street stencil of a hooded skull-faced reaper with a small ankh at its chest, on a dark spray-painted wall. A row of three Mr. Snowmann snowmen with raised arms occupies the upper-left, anchoring the composition.
works.composition: central reaper stencil with snowman row at upper left

works.title: Wall and Pavement, Snowmen
works.description: Two-register street photograph: above, a cubist red, white and blue paste-up reading 'CARRIER' and 'EAR' with stylised faces in linocut style; below, a cream pavement covered in black graffiti tags hosts three small white Mr. Snowmann figures in spread formation.
works.composition: two-register: paste-up wall above, tagged pavement below

works.title: Plastic-Wrapped Disc
works.description: A near-monochrome wall piece: a black panel sealed under shrink-wrapped clear plastic, with a single gold compact disc tucked at the lower-centre. The wrinkled plastic and silver foil texture catches light unevenly across the surface.
works.composition: monochrome wrapped panel, single disc anchor

works.title: Robot, Keyboard Mouth
works.description: A wall-mounted figure on black ground: a red torso with two gold compact disc eyes, a computer keyboard set as a horizontal mouth, and a stack of small spool icons crowning the head. Plastic wrapping reflects across the upper register.
works.composition: anthropomorphic central figure on black ground

works.title: No More Poor Doors
works.description: A Mr. Snowmann paste-up on a blue painted utility box: three white snowmen on a red panel above a black silhouette holding a placard reading 'NO MORE POOR DOORS'. Sticker remnants and 'CLYDE P' tag flank the lower edges; brick wall background.
works.composition: central paste-up on blue utility box

works.title: Sticker Door
works.description: A red door divided into upper and lower panels: dense saturated stickers crowd the upper window — 'CODEFC', 'METRO', 'OLE', 'ABOVE' tags layered to white-out. Below, a stenciled black-line face with a red ankh, a small black tuxedoed figure, and the painted phrase 'ALONE' frame the lower glass.
works.composition: two-panel red door with stickers above, stencil below

works.title: How Will This Benefit Me
works.description: A brown-painted door dense with paste-ups and tags. A blue-faced military figure in epaulettes and skull-cap hat occupies the lower centre with the painted question 'How will this benefit me?' beside it. A snowman icon and various stickers crowd the upper register.
works.composition: central paste-up with text on tagged door

works.title: Two Faces, Snowman Field
works.description: A pale street wall with two stenciled faces in black and blue spray, one with a red ball-eye, the other in profile. A scatter of small Mr. Snowmann figures fills the lower register, alongside a black radial-rayed skull motif. Loose, sketched, character-driven.
works.composition: stencil cluster on wall, snowman scatter base

works.title: TEAR Figure
works.description: A black linocut-style street paste-up of a tall figure in striped clothing, tears falling on small black-and-white labels reading 'TEAR'. A stripe-faced head crowns the figure; the wall behind is a deep blue. A solitary, mournful, woodcut feel.
works.composition: central tall paste-up on blue wall

works.title: Dance Club Records
works.description: A red brick wall painted with a large blue spray-painted skull above a stenciled black panel reading 'DANCE CLUB RECORDS'. A row of three white snowmen stands at left; a black and white linocut eye-and-tear motif occupies the lower-right.
works.composition: central skull with text panel on red brick

works.title: Plane and Sport Cards
works.description: A central top-down warplane drawing fills the white panel, framed by yellow and red taped vertical stripes. Three gold compact discs anchor the upper edge; sports trading cards line the left and right margins; two Rolling Stones tongue logos with footballs sit at the lower base.
works.composition: central plane on taped panel with sport-card margins

works.title: Hot Pink Tag, Snowman Trio
works.description: A dense graffitied wall with overlapping spray tags in turquoise, magenta, white and black. A small white snowman trio is tucked into the centre of the field; the saturated, illegible mass of letters reads as collective noise.
works.composition: all-over graffiti field with central snowman trio

works.title: Rifle Stencil, Snowman
works.description: A black wall hosts a stenciled standing figure holding an AK-47 above the painted text 'BENNAZ'. A small Mr. Snowmann with hat and glasses sits at upper centre; a yellow comic-book skyscraper paste-up on the right edge punctuates the dark wall.
works.composition: central rifle stencil with text and snowman icon

works.title: Yellow Mountains, Snowman
works.description: A brick archway frames a tall yellow-and-black mural of triangular mountain forms layered with patterned circles, spirals and zigzag fills. A small Mr. Snowmann with arms raised crowns the upper right; a dense decorative woodcut feel.
works.composition: central archway mural, patterned mountain field

works.title: Car Park, Snowman Cat
works.description: An urban street view: a 'CAR PARK' arrow sign on the left, a wheat-pasted black-and-white cat-face mural over a building entrance at centre, and a row of three Mr. Snowmann figures riding a small platform at upper left. A red car is parked in the foreground.
works.composition: central paste-up over urban entrance

works.title: Installation View, Pop Wall
works.description: Wide horizontal installation photograph of a long gallery wall hung with banners and posters in saturated reds, yellows and blacks. The view captures the artist's signature dense field of pop-collage works mounted as a single horizontal sweep, with concrete floor and white side walls.
works.composition: wide horizontal panorama, gallery wall sweep

works.title: Lehrjahre Face
works.description: A street wall layered in paste-ups and tags: a black-and-white dripping face poster reading 'LEHRJAHRE' anchors the centre, surrounded by torn papers, green and red spray-paint gestures and a small Mr. Snowmann at lower left.
works.composition: central paste-up face on layered tag wall

works.title: Red Meerkat, Snowman
works.description: A standing red-painted meerkat dominates a brick wall against a lurid yellow-and-black sunset. A small Mr. Snowmann figure with hat and glasses stands to the right at the same horizon line; a snowman tag and 'OSCH' signature mark the lower left.
works.composition: central tall figure on landscape wall

works.title: Embracing Lovers
works.description: A pale street wall hosts a loose orange-and-black mural of two embracing figures painted in continuous-line gesture, with red accents marking face and hands. A Mr. Snowmann stands at left wearing a Pierrot hat; a snowman trio anchors the lower-left base. Signed 'Ricky Bird'.
works.composition: central figure mural with snowman witnesses

works.title: Disc Altar with Keyboard
works.description: A wall altar on black ground: a horizontal speaker bar at top, a stacked cluster of gold compact discs descending the central foil-wrapped panel, a computer keyboard set as a horizontal mouth, and a base of vertical white-and-blue printed strips with hanging cables. Three gold discs pin the lower edge.
works.composition: vertical altar with disc stack and keyboard mouth

works.title: Installation View, Studio Panorama
works.description: Wide horizontal panorama of a studio interior, walls hung with collage and pop-art works in saturated reds, oranges and patterned panels. Concrete floor and warm interior light frame the long view across the room.

works.title: Three Pawns
works.description: Three large black chess pawns stand in formation across the upper half of a white field. Below, two silver compact discs flank a hand-drawn football and small snowman; a third disc anchors the lower edge. Sequined panel and small numerals scatter through the margins.
works.composition: central pawn trio above disc and football base

works.title: Installation View, Andrea Allison
works.description: Wide horizontal installation panorama of a gallery wall hung with two large patterned collage panels in red, white, and target rings. The gallery name 'ANDREA ALLISON' appears on the right wall; warm interior light across the long view.

works.title: Installation View, Gallery Sweep
works.description: Wide horizontal panorama of a gallery interior with red and patterned collage works on the left wall and 'ANDREA ALLISON' signage on the right. White walls and concrete floor frame the show across the full breadth of the room.

works.title: Tabernacle and Bins
works.description: A floor-standing assemblage in two registers: an upper horizontal cabinet of layered collage panels, photographs and a small white airplane silhouette; below, three vertical box-like cabinets fronted with patterned panels, target shapes and a small painted football. Saturated cabinetry.
works.composition: two-register sculpture, horizontal cabinet over three vertical boxes

works.title: Studio Aisle, Crosses
works.description: A studio interior view down a working corridor: a row of orange-and-white cross-shaped sculptural pieces stand on the floor against the right wall, with a black plastic curtain at left and additional saturated panels deeper in the room.

works.title: Studio, Vertical Cross Pieces
works.description: Studio view of multiple cross-form sculptures lined up against a black-plastic-curtained wall. Each piece is a vertical patterned panel mounted on a base; bright colours and target shapes punctuate the row. An orange traffic cone sits at lower centre.

works.title: Studio, Forklift and Crosses
works.description: Studio shot of a forklift positioned beside a row of large cross-form sculptural panels stacked against the rear wall. Reflective bronze and saturated patterned surfaces catch the work light; concrete floor and the word 'FORKLIFT' printed across the lower left.

works.title: Triptych, Three Discs on Copper
works.description: A horizontal triptych: two outer panels of saturated green foil flank a central copper panel hosting three gold compact discs in a vertical stack. The metallic surfaces catch light unevenly, with painted edges and rough taped seams.
works.composition: horizontal triptych, central disc stack on copper
